name: clean-settled-batch
rule: clean control: paced batches with allSettled, failures logged and counted
body: Fetches reference prices for a list of names a batch at a time, paced to the API's 60 calls a minute. A name whose lookup keeps failing transiently is retried, then skipped, logged and counted, so the caller can tell a missing price from a price the API does not know. An auth answer or an exhausted quota rejects the fetch instead of being retried.
